title: The Marked Door
logline: The thieves' spies mark Ali Baba's door twice, with chalk and then with red paint, and twice the clever Morgiana copies the mark onto every door in the street; the leader decides to come himself.
moral: A calm, clever head beats force: one who notices small things and thinks protects the whole house.
tone: Light caper comedy with a clever heroine; night scenes are sneaky rather than frightening; a quiet threat at the very end.

beats.summary: The leader sends a disguised man to the town to find Ali Baba's house.
In the market nobody knows, until a gold coin gives the spy his clue and a thumb points at the narrow street.
The spy chalks a small white cross beside Ali Baba's door.
He congratulates himself and dreams of his reward.
She stops mid-step: she has seen the mark.
Only our door: she reasons it out and knows there is a secret.
She copies the cross beside every neighbouring door.
At night the spy finds the whole street marked.
WHICH DOOR?! The spy cannot answer; the thieves withdraw.
Next day a second spy is sent with a different mark, red paint.
A red dot on Ali Baba's door.
Morgiana laughs quietly at the window and dots every door.
The thieves return and again cannot tell the house.
The leader understands: someone here is cleverer than we are. He will come himself.
Morgiana warns Ali Baba to beware of strangers.
That evening an oil merchant with laden mules knocks and asks to stay the night.

subtitles.ar: أرسل قائد اللصوص رجلًا إلى البلدة ليبحث عن بيت علي بابا.|تجول الرجل في السوق وسأل أسئلة كثيرة، حتى وجد دليلًا قاده إلى شارع ضيق.
subtitles.en: The thieves’ leader sent a man to town to find Ali Baba’s house.|The man wandered through the market asking questions until a clue led him into a narrow street.

subtitles.ar: وقف الجاسوس أمام بيت علي بابا، ورسم علامة صغيرة بالطبشور الأبيض قرب الباب.|ابتسم وقال لنفسه: «سأعود ليلًا، وسيعرف القائد المكان من هذه العلامة».
subtitles.en: The spy stopped outside Ali Baba’s house and drew a little white chalk mark beside the door.|He smiled to himself: “I’ll return tonight, and the leader will recognize this place from the mark.”

subtitles.ar: لكن مرجانة، المرأة الذكية التي تساعد أهل البيت، لاحظت العلامة عندما عادت من السوق.|نظرت حولها وفكرت: «لماذا يختار أحدهم بابنا وحده؟|لا بد أن وراء الأمر سرًا».
subtitles.en: But Morgiana, the clever woman who helped the household, noticed the mark when she returned from market.|She looked around and thought, “Why would someone choose only our door?|There must be a secret behind it.”

subtitles.ar: أحضرت مرجانة قطعة طبشور، ورسمت العلامة نفسها على أبواب البيوت المجاورة.|وعندما عاد الجاسوس مع اللصوص ليلًا،|وجد الشارع كله يحمل العلامة البيضاء نفسها.
subtitles.en: Morgiana brought chalk and copied the mark onto neighboring doors.|When the spy returned with the thieves after dark,|he found the whole street bearing the same white mark.

subtitles.ar: غضب القائد وسأل الجاسوس: «أي باب نريد؟»|لم يستطع الرجل الإجابة.|انسحبوا، وفي اليوم التالي أرسل القائد جاسوسًا آخر بعلامة مختلفة.
subtitles.en: The leader angrily asked the spy, “Which door do we want?”|The man could not answer.|They withdrew, and the next day the leader sent another spy with a different mark.

subtitles.ar: وضع الجاسوس الثاني نقطة حمراء على باب علي بابا، ثم ابتعد.|رأتها مرجانة من النافذة،|فضحكت بهدوء، ووضعت نقاطًا حمراء مثلها على سائر الأبواب.
subtitles.en: The second spy placed a red dot on Ali Baba’s door and walked away.|Morgiana saw it from the window,|smiled quietly, and painted matching red dots on all the other doors.

subtitles.ar: عاد اللصوص مرة أخرى، فلم يعرفوا البيت.|قال القائد: «في هذا الشارع شخص أذكى منا».|وقرر أن يأتي بنفسه بدل إرسال جاسوس ثالث.
subtitles.en: The thieves returned, but still could not identify the house.|“Someone on this street is cleverer than we are,” said the leader.|He decided to come himself instead of sending a third spy.

subtitles.ar: أخبرت مرجانة علي بابا، وطلبت منه الحذر من الغرباء.|وفي المساء وصل رجل يقود دواب تحمل جرار زيت، وطلب المبيت.
subtitles.en: Morgiana warned Ali Baba to beware of strangers.|That evening, a man arrived leading animals laden with oil jars and asked to stay the night.

new_assets.implementation: abMorgiana(ctx, P, m) beside abWife in ab_cast.js: abPerson with costume 'villageWoman', pal from abPal(AB_MORG0, m) then pal.hc and pal.sash forced to AB_MORG_ACC. Scarf tail: 6-point ribbon from the back of the head, y offset A*sin(k*i - 9*tc) plus lagged body x velocity, drawn with celShade before the figure. windowBust: draw the figure with feet at sill y + 150 inside ctx.clip of the window rect so only chest and head show; arms via handLW/handRW on the sill.

new_assets.name: townStreet (models day, night, evening)
new_assets.description: The narrow street of Ali Baba's house for episodes 3 to 6: painted strip 2000 x 1230 with five house fronts, five doors in five colours, Ali Baba's window, courtyard wall and gate, market arch, skyline, washing lines and street dressing; three colour models. Exact coordinates in sets.townStreetDay. Exports anchors TS = {doors: [{cx, x0, x1, top, mark: [x, y], dot: [x, y]}], window, gate, arch, line}.
new_assets.implementation: abStreetPlate(m) with abBakeAt per model: sky by abGrad + abCloud + abSun or moon; skyline with abSoftHills-style blurred shapes; house fronts with celShade rectangles (wall, parapet, beam ends) as in abVillage and abCottage, palette row per model (AB_STREET[m] = sky stops, wall colours, line, glow). Live parts over the plate: Library townDoor for the five doors and the gate (open 0..1), townWindow for Ali Baba's window (shutters, lit), lantern glows with abGlow and a 12 fps flicker, washing as cloth ribbons, doorMark list. Time-lapse = drawImage of two model plates with globalAlpha cross-fade (backgrounds may blend; cels never) while the sun or moon is drawn live.

new_assets.name: doorMark (chalk cross and red dot) with chalk and paintPot
new_assets.description: doorMark(ctx, x, y, {kind: 'x' or 'dot', p, glow, s}): the white chalk cross 36 x 36 and the red dot r 14 described in props, with draw-on progress, a ring pulse helper and a flare for night; chalk stick and paint pot with brush as hand props.
new_assets.implementation: Cross: two seg() strokes clipped by p, round rough ends from 3 short offset segs; abGlow white alpha 0.35 behind. Dot: ell() with celShade and a highlight, scale by a back-ease pop. Marks are stored in a list [{door, kind, t0}] so every shot draws the right ones for its time.

new_assets.name: oilJar with jarPannier (and the silverRing hand insert)
new_assets.description: The oil merchant's cargo for episodes 3 and 4: jar 70 x 150 (s field for the 110 x 230 courtyard size), lid 0..1, stain, rope net; pannier frame putting two jars on a mule; the silver ring with the split blue stone on the knocking fist (ALI-01 abHandCel).
new_assets.implementation: Jar outline from 10 mirrored points through celShade (#c8743a, shade #8a4a2a, highlight band on the shoulder), lid as a flat ellipse offset by lid*12 with a dark gap under it, net as 4 arcs and 3 verticals. Pannier: two seg() poles crossing over mountSeat('donkey', P), jars hung from the pole ends with lagged sway. Ring: ell band #d8dce8 + stone #3a8ae8 with a dark diagonal seg and abGlint.

new_assets.name: spyDisguise and oilMerchant (palette and overlay variants)

new_assets.name: sneakChain
new_assets.description: A single file of tiptoeing figures that follows a leader position function with per-member delay, a high-knee short stride and an accordion bump when the leader stops; also runs in reverse for the withdrawal.
new_assets.implementation: x_i(t) = xf(t - 0.35*i) - gap*i; pose = walk(x_i, tc, {stride: 0.6 * default}) with amp 1.3, tip 0.06, arms tucked; bump = lurch(t, tStop + 0.35*i) on tip. Sampled at celStep(t,12).

new_assets.name: dayToNight time-lapse
new_assets.description: In-shot passage of time on a painted set: cross-fade between two or three colour models of the same plate while the sun sets or the moon rises live and lanterns and windows light one by one.
new_assets.implementation: k = kfn(t, keys); draw plate A, then plate B with globalAlpha k; sun y from kfn; lantern i on when k > 0.3 + 0.12*i. Cast drawn after, untinted.

owner_questions: The film ends on TO BE CONTINUED... instead of THE END because the script stops as the oil merchant knocks; default: TO BE CONTINUED... (episode 2 used THE END).

The clue the script leaves open is staged as a market seller showing off a gold coin and pointing at the lane, and the spy recognises the house by Ali Baba's olive robe and vermilion sash on the washing line and his donkey at the gate; default: kept.
The chalk mark is a small white cross (X) and the second mark a round red dot on the door itself; Morgiana's red is henna from a kitchen bowl; default: kept.

Invented English balloon lines: FIND HIS HOUSE!, ALI BABA?, THAT WAY!, I'LL BE BACK TONIGHT!, WHY ONLY OUR DOOR?, THERE IS A SECRET!, THIS ONE! NO... THIS ONE?, WHICH DOOR?!, UH..., HEE HEE, SOMEONE ON THIS STREET IS CLEVERER THAN US!, I WILL COME MYSELF., BEWARE OF STRANGERS!, A BED FOR THE NIGHT?; default: kept as written.
Morgiana's design: cream dress, violet waistcoat, turquoise headscarf and sash as her one accent colour for episodes 3 to 6; default: turquoise #14c2c8.
The oil merchant is drawn with the leader's build and beard and a thin crimson cloak lining, but is not named or unmasked here (episode 4 narrates it); default: a hint only.

Additions that set up later episodes: the silver ring with the split blue stone on the knocking hand, one jar lid that lifts slightly by itself (no eyes shown), and Morgiana watching unseen from the window during both night visits; default: all three included.

Comic additions beyond the script: the first spy dreaming of a reward, the practice red dot on his turban, a third volunteer with blue paint pushed back by the face, the old neighbour let into the joke; default: included.
The day to night changes at 64.9 and 134.9 are shown as in-shot time-lapses, and only the next-day change at 86.3 uses the tape transition with the caption NEXT DAY...; default: as described.
implementation_notes: Copy the ALI-01-ANIME sources (ab_kit.js, ab_cast.js, ab_sets.js and the reusable parts of ab_main.js) and ALI-02's additions (glade 'morning' model, farTown, tiptoeFreeze) into Animations/ALI-03/src/ and extend there. Frame order: S.background, S.box panel, plate (and cross-fade), live set parts (doors, window, lanterns, washing, marks), cels, light (abGlow, abBands, rims), lettering, transition, subtitle, S.finish last.

Pose every character at tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) (12 fps); blinks and lip flaps at celStep(t, 8). Camera, plate cross-fades, lantern glow, glints, counters and the tape transition run on every frame.

Word cues with w(p, n) from timing.json; all cue times in this plan are word starts from inputs/timeline.md. Subtitle chunks are already in chunks_ar.txt / chunks_en.txt and timing.json; use timing.json as it stands.

Clue continuity: washing line with the olive robe and vermilion sash and the donkey at the gate are present in every DAY street scene and absent in both NIGHT scenes (taken in during the time-lapse at 65.0 and 135.5).

Balloons with abSay (S.label {balloon: true, to}) at size 52 (58 for WHICH DOOR?!), tail on the speaker's head, removed 0.4 s after the last cue, never over a face, a door mark or the window. Tags (MORGIANA, ALI BABA'S HOUSE, HEE HEE) are plain labels at 40 or more. The ? glyphs and picture balloons carry no words.

Up to six figures in single file at night (S8, S14) plus live doors, lanterns and marks: bake the plate per model and skip anything off screen.
